source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_operator.py -k "ingress or review or remediation or repair or publication" -q

claims.claim: REVIEW, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR commits now inherit their exact predecessor trees, use the required sole parent, add only their derived metadata path, validate exact content and structure before ref publication, and use fail-closed expected-missing ref updates.
Review decisions preserve the candidate workflow blob and remain separate from implementation main publication.
Structurally valid replay remains idempotent, while malformed or conflicting destinations fail closed without overwriting remote refs; historical content remains readable.
AUTHOR_TASK retains its existing main predecessor, exact TASK-path delta, and compare-and-swap behavior.
Focused regressions directly inspect sole parents, exact changed paths, metadata bytes, inherited review/workflow blobs, idempotency, and malformed replay behavior for all three mutation families.
